citation: Simonis-Bik AM, et al. The heritability of beta cell function parameters in a mixed meal test design. Diabetologia 2011.
protocol: Mixed meal after an overnight fast (men: 110 g brown bread, 20 g margarine, 25 g cheese, 30 g jam, 19 g honey cake, 200 mL milk; 3024 kJ, 89 g carbohydrate, 30 g fat, 24.4 g protein; women 79% of it); samples to 240 min (10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 210, 240)
population: n=183 healthy Dutch twins and siblings (77 men), age 20-49 y

reports.where: Table 1 and text (summary indices, insulin secretion rates; check for curve values)

note: Longest healthy sampling and a printed meal, with C-peptide-derived secretion rates; the paper may print only summary indices (OGIS, ISR, AUC), so the reader may need to refuse.
